title: The Nihilist Reading Of Embalming (manga) #Shorts
description:
The unconscious does not argue with Embalming (manga); it simply acts first. Embalming: The Another Tale of Frankenstein is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Nobuhiro Watsuki, with occasional writing assistance from his wife Kaoru Kurosaki. It was serialized in Shueisha's monthly shōnen manga magazine Jump Square from November 2007 to April 2015, with its chapters collected in ten tankōbon volumes.

The self that experiences Embalming (manga) is a committee, not a king. Shueisha collected its chapters in ten tankōbon volumes, released from September 4, 2008, to May 1, 2015. Several volumes of Embalming have been featured on Oricon's weekly chart of the best-selling manga; five straight volumes (3 to 7) have reached the top 20 in a span of four years.
